posts.title: My now playing widget
posts.description: So I saw that some people on the IndieWeb have on their personal website a now playing or last scrobbled widget, linked to their last.fm. posts.title: simply Hosting my git repos
posts.description: I have some projects for which I use Git as my source control, such as this website. For this, I need a Git hosting service. For a long time, I used GitHub for this, but due to their instability and questionable policies, I don't want to host there anymore.
